definitions.explanation: A person who invents things, especially someone known for creating new devices or methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偉|えら}い→偉い：00039_erai⟧{発明家|はつめいか}。
⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{発明家|はつめいか}。
examples.english: An inventor who left their mark on history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{発明家|はつめいか}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{発明家|はつめいか} refers to a person who creates new devices, methods, or technologies. The word combines ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧ (invention) with the suffix ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional/expert).

FORMS:
⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧ (invention) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (suffix for a person skilled in something)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧: invention
- ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to invent
- ⟦{発明品|はつめいひん}→発明品：27729_hatsumeihin⟧: an invented product

SIMILAR {家|か} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧: scientist (uses ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ instead of ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧)
- ⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧: artist
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer/author
